capabilities: Clean Mermaid.js flowchart code by moving variable declarations to the top
Apply regex-based style and class rules to Mermaid code
Create empty files from a selected list of titles
Create files from selected H2 sections
Convert lists of strings into wiki links and copy global graph color groups to local graph
extras: Copying global color groups to the local graph requires restarting Obsidian after running the command.
problem: Obsidian renders Mermaid diagrams but offers no commands to tidy or modify Mermaid source code, and lacks quick utilities like batch file creation from selected text.
summary: Adds commands to clean and transform Mermaid.js flowchart code, plus utilities for creating files from lists and converting lists to links.
